hero.subtitle: A space where aesthetic medicine, nutrition and healthy habits work together — so feeling well shows in the way you look.

philosophy.heading: It’s not only about looking well.
philosophy.rest: feeling well — and keeping it over time.
philosophy.body: We work one-on-one, listening and tailoring each treatment to what each person really needs. No unrealistic expectations. With judgement, empathy and a complete view of wellbeing.

pillars.p1Body: Every decision takes your story, skin and goals into account — not passing trends.
pillars.p2Body: Aesthetic medicine + nutrition + habits. Results last when everything aligns.
pillars.p3Body: Safe interventions that enhance without erasing what makes you you.

treatments.heading: Tailored facial
treatments.subheading: Twenty-four procedures organised along four complementary paths. Each plan is designed during the initial consultation, based on a full diagnosis.

limpieza.name: Deep facial cleanse
limpieza.short: Professional hygiene that renews texture and glow.
limpieza.long: Hygienising cleanse with extraction, exfoliation and calming mask. Monthly maintenance keeps skin balanced.

limpieza-alquimia.name: Deep facial cleanse with Alquimia
limpieza-alquimia.short: Hygienising ritual powered by high-performance cosmetics.
limpieza-alquimia.long: Combines deep cleansing with Alquimia-lab actives: vitamin C, mild acids and peptide serums. Skin primed, nourished and luminous.

peeling.name: Peeling
peeling.short: Controlled cellular renewal with medical acids.
peeling.long: Acid application that accelerates cell turnover and treats spots, uneven texture, enlarged pores and signs of ageing.

radiofrecuencia.name: Radiofrequency
radiofrecuencia.short: Stimulates collagen and tightens skin, non-invasive.
radiofrecuencia.long: Electromagnetic waves heat the deep dermis, stimulating collagen and improving firmness with zero downtime.

fraxface.name: Fraxface
fraxface.short: Microneedling that renews skin from within.
fraxface.long: Fractional treatment creating micro-channels to stimulate deep regeneration. Ideal for scars, pores, texture and luminosity.

hifu-facial.name: HIFU 25D 360 Max with Liposonix
hifu-facial.short: Non-surgical facial lift through focused ultrasound.
hifu-facial.long: High-intensity focused ultrasound working at different depths. Tightens, redefines contour and treats double chin — a surgical lift without a cut.

prp.name: Platelet-rich plasma
prp.short: Your own blood as a regenerative active.
prp.long: Blood extraction and centrifugation to apply platelet growth factors. Regenerates, revitalises and improves skin quality.

meso-facial.name: Facial mesotherapy
meso-facial.short: Micro-infiltration of actives that restore glow and firmness.
meso-facial.long: A cocktail of vitamins, hyaluronic acid and antioxidants in intradermal micro-doses. Hydrates, brightens and improves skin quality.

meso-ojeras.name: Under-eye mesotherapy
meso-ojeras.short: Targeted treatment for the eye contour.
meso-ojeras.long: Selected actives for pigmentation and bags in the under-eye area. Brightens, decongests and refreshes the gaze.

skinbooster.name: Skinbooster
skinbooster.long: Non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid that restores hydration, density and elasticity. Results hold for six months.

botox.name: Botox
botox.long: Botulinum toxin applied in individualised doses — forehead, glabella, crow’s feet. Natural results that preserve expression.

relleno.name: Hyaluronic acid filler
relleno.short: Recover volume without changing your identity.
relleno.long: Hyaluronic acid fillers for lips, cheekbones, chin, folds and under-eye. Bespoke facial design with a natural outcome.

radiesse.name: Biostimulators (Radiesse)
radiesse.long: Calcium hydroxylapatite triggers endogenous collagen production. Firmness, density and skin quality improve progressively.

prp-capilar.name: Hair platelet-rich plasma
prp-capilar.short: Scalp regeneration with your own growth factors.
prp-capilar.long: Blood extraction and centrifugation to apply platelet growth factors to the scalp. Stimulates follicles, slows hair loss and strengthens hair.

meso-capilar.name: Hair mesotherapy
meso-capilar.short: Micro-infiltration of actives that nourish the follicle.
meso-capilar.long: Vitamin, mineral and amino-acid cocktail applied in micro-doses to the scalp. Revitalises the bulb, improves density and hair quality.

criolipolisis.name: Cryolipolysis
criolipolisis.short: Localised fat reduction through controlled cold.
criolipolisis.long: Sustained cold that crystallises adipocytes in specific zones. The body eliminates them naturally over the following weeks. Ideal for abdomen, flanks, back and thighs.

body-up.name: Body Up
body-up.long: Deep muscular stimulation that firms, activates circulation and improves body tone. Complements reduction and remodelling plans.

peptonas.name: Peptonas
peptonas.short: Reduction and remodelling with collagen peptides.
peptonas.long: Micro-infiltration of peptonas that break down localised fat tissue and trigger body remodelling. Suitable for arms, abdomen, flanks and legs.

meso-celulitis.name: Cellulite mesotherapy
meso-celulitis.long: Micro-infiltration of specific actives that improve circulation, drain fluids and target fat nodules. Serial protocol for visible results.

enzimas-lipoliticas.name: Lipolytic enzymes
enzimas-lipoliticas.long: Application of enzymes that break down adipose cells in specific zones. Measurable reduction in a few sessions.

hifu-corporal.name: HIFU 25D 360 Max with Liposonix — body
hifu-corporal.short: Body tightening and remodelling via ultrasound.
hifu-corporal.long: Focused ultrasound applied to body zones — abdomen, arms, legs, glutes. Tightens, redefines contours and reduces localised adiposity.

depilacion.name: Laser hair removal
depilacion.long: Progressive laser hair removal for definitive results. Protocol tailored to skin type, phototype and the area being treated.

consulta-medica.name: Medical aesthetic consultation
consulta-medica.long: In-depth interview, skin assessment and definition of an integral aesthetic plan. The starting point for any treatment — with no commitment.

nutricion.name: Nutrition consultation
nutricion.short: Nutritional support that sustains the results.
nutricion.long: Personalised eating plan that complements the aesthetic journey. Sustainable habits so results hold over time.

about.heading: Two sisters,
about.intro: D’Ursi Estética was born from a very personal place: the idea of approaching beauty in a real, mindful, integral way. We are Estefanía and Vanina — each with her own path, sharing the same view of wellbeing.
about.vaninaBio: Medical doctor specialised in aesthetic medicine. I’ve worked in the field since I was 18 — first in dermatocosmetics and cosmetic chemistry, then across aesthetic and dermatology centres. I deepened my training with postgraduate programs and a master’s degree in facial harmonisation — always focused on natural, safe results.
about.vaninaOff: Off-hours: pilates, books, constant learning, travel and mate.
about.estefaniaBio: Licensed nutritionist. For years I was a patient and walked through several centres — that experience shaped how I wanted to work: with empathy, judgement and a complete view. I accompany the process from habits and nutrition so aesthetic results hold over time.
about.estefaniaOff: Off-hours: drawing, painting, friends, family, travel and a good table.

space.heading: Paternal,
space.body: An intimate practice, designed so each consultation is personalised and unhurried. By appointment only — this way every treatment gets the time it deserves.

contact.heading: Let’s
contact.body: Message us on WhatsApp to schedule your first consultation. Same-day replies.
